_meta.source: Live scrape of bazargoo.com on 2026-11-08. Product list discovered from https://bazargoo.com/sitemap.xml (111 products). For each product page, name/price/image taken from the JSON-LD Product block (offers.price) and category from the JSON-LD BreadcrumbList; compare-at price from the page markup. Cross-checked: Samsung TV ৳75,000, AirPods Pro ৳30,000, Single Night Vision Sunglass ৳198, Flawless Facial Hair Remover ৳849, 5 Layer Shoe Rack ৳496 all match the store's live listings.
_meta.live_feed: No public live product feed exists on bazargoo.com (tested 2026-11-08: /products.json 404, /api/products 404, /api/store/products 404, /sitemap-products.xml 404; sitemap.xml lists URLs only, no prices). Prices therefore come from this bundled products.json. To refresh: run sync-products.py in this folder — it re-fetches the sitemap + every product page and rewrites products.json. No app rebuild needed. A scheduled sync (e.g. daily) keeps prices fresh.
_meta.note: Store's own spellings kept as-is in 'category': 'Cleanning', 'Kithen'. Merged duplicates: 'Home Appliance' into 'Home Appliances', 'Book' into 'Books' (same category, two spellings on the store).
